messages.subject: GCC Energy & Industrial Executive | Government Relations, ESG & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear RydeQuest Team,

Your executive-search and HR advisory work across energy, industrial, engineering and corporate leadership in the GCC makes this a focused introduction.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My leadership scope includes government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates across Saudi Arabia, the UAE and wider GCC where institutional relationships, responsible development, stakeholder leadership and regulatory execution are critical to growth. I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate appointments.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
